import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Filter out derived features for driver selection
    non_derived_ids = [fid for fid, t in zip(feats.ids, feats.types) if t != 'derived']
    
    # Simple approach: just use the top 3 features by effect size
    effects = []
    for fid in non_derived_ids:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, idx]
        y = feats.y
        mean1 = np.mean(x[y == 1])
        mean0 = np.mean(x[y == 0])
        effect_size = mean1 - mean0
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(x[y == 1], x[y == 0], equal_var=False)
        effects.append((fid, effect_size, p_val))
    
    # Sort by effect size (absolute) and p-value
    effects.sort(key=lambda x: (-abs(x[1]), x[2]))
    
    # Take top 3 features
    top_features = [fid for fid, _, _ in effects[:3]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    kept = []
    if top_features:
        # Build correlation matrix for top features
        X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in top_features]]
        corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(X.T)
        
        for i, fid1 in enumerate(top_features):
            is_duplicate = False
            for fid2 in kept:
                j = top_features.index(fid2)
                if abs(corr_matrix[i, j]) >= 0.6:
                    is_duplicate = True
                    break
            if not is_duplicate:
                kept.append(fid1)
    
    # Select drivers using logistic regression with L1 penalty
    drivers = ()
    if kept:
        X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in kept]]
        model = LogisticRegression(penalty='l1', solver='liblinear', random_state=42)
        model.fit(X, feats.y)
        
        # Get feature importance (non-zero coefficients)
        coefs = model.coef_[0]
        important_indices = np.where(coefs != 0)[0]
        
        if len(important_indices) > 0:
            # Rank by absolute coefficient value
            ranked = sorted(zip(important_indices, coefs[important_indices]), 
                          key=lambda x: -abs(x[1]))
            drivers = tuple([kept[i] for i, _ in ranked[:MAX_DRIVERS]])
    
    # For columns, use all non-derived features but limit to 5
    columns = tuple(non_derived_ids[:5])
    
    # For products, check top correlated pairs among kept features
    products = []
    if len(kept) > 1:
        X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in kept]]
        corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(X.T)
        for i in range(len(kept)):
            for j in range(i+1, len(kept)):
                if abs(corr_matrix[i, j]) >= 0.6:
                    products.append((kept[i], kept[j]))
    
    # Loadings - simple sum of top features
    loadings = {}
    if kept:
        # Use first feature with highest absolute effect size
        if effects:
            best_fid, effect, _ = effects[0]
            loadings[best_fid] = effect
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
